title: Session
description: JSON Schema for a session — a temporally-ordered set of turns conducted by one character against one inference model in one connected run. Identity is the session-id (a kebab-case name). Specializes thing via allOf with cells naming the character running the session and the inference-model the session runs against. The ordered sequence of turns lives as EAVT cell-records in the session-instance's jsonl, not as a field on this record.

character.description: The slug of the character conducting the session. References doing/governing/characters/<character>/.

inference-model.description: The slug or version-string of the inference-model the session runs against (e.g., claude-opus-4-7).

started-at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the session opened. Optional at the schema layer; the canonical record is the EAVT row whose `a` is `opening-a-session` in the session's jsonl.

ended-at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the session closed. Optional; absence means the session is still open.
